run.name: CHS Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (CHSCP)
run.summary: CHS has a solid fundamental credit profile on reported figures: low year-end leverage of 1.27x and ample committed liquidity. Its earnings are volatile and policy-dependent, so the profile is strong but cyclical. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CHS INC.

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Derived EBITDA 1,969,497 (C1); total debt 2,501,725 and net debt 2,238,122 (C5), USD thousands; year-end seasonal low in short-term borrowing, so interim leverage is higher

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Derived EBITDA 1,969,497 over cash paid for interest 167,057 (C1, C6); preferred dividends of 168,668 are not in the denominator

cash.basis: Cash. Revolver commitment 2,800.0 with no borrowings at 2026-08-31 (10-K page:163); letters of credit drawn on it not supplied so availability may be lower; securitization and repurchase capacity excluded because the committed share is not separable; excludes restricted cash of 123.217

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, guarantors, letter of credit usage and fiscal 2024 debt are not supplied, and EBITDA is derived rather than reported.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is derived, not reported, includes equity income and ignores major maintenance spending. Covenant levels, letter of credit usage and fiscal 2024 debt are not supplied.
